feeds.title: Rum Diaries Blog
feeds.description: Hii! I am Steven James. This is where I make some attempt to explain why I've decided to write about Rum.

feeds.title: Robs Rum Guide
feeds.description: Robs Rum Guide is the source for fresh rum news and updates on new rum products, new producers, and items of interest to rum enthusiasts.

feeds.title: The Rum Company Blog
feeds.description: A one-stop-shop for everything rum, providing helpful taste notes, the latest rum news, mixer recommendations, and cocktail recipes. The Rum Company is a dedicated online rum shop selling rums from all over Britain.

feeds.title: Rumporter
feeds.description: Discover all the rum-related news, facts, and information all around the world brought to you by Rumporter. Read the magazine for all the rum-related articles like Giving Rum is Proof of Love, a summary of the winter 2022 edition, and many more! Rumporter tries to explore all that is to be known about rums.

feeds.title: Single Cask Rum
feeds.description: Single Cask Rum is a blog on rum. The content of this blog is mainly intended for more advanced rum drinkers. You should have got a broad idea of the different rum styles as well as some experience with drinking rums at higher drinking- or cask strength. Furthermore, you should enjoy natural, non-sweetened rums.

feeds.title: The Rum Barrel Blog
feeds.description: The Rum Barrel Blog is a blog about rum by Alexandru Sandu. He writes rum reviews and personal opinions to help educate others about the intricacies of rum. He is a cocktail bartender and rum enthusiast based in London.

feeds.title: The Rum Geography Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Rum Geography, the ultimate resource for rum enthusiasts of all levels. We've mapped out the rum world, and are here to help you explore it in your way. A gateway for producers, enthusiasts, and destinations. Whether you're a newcomer or a rum geek, we never stop learning. Our comprehensive directory of rum producers includes everything you need to know, from amenities and rum styles to profiles and methods.

feeds.title: Rum Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Let Rum Therapy help you to plan your next island vacation. With personal travel photos and rum inspired resort wear, because everyone needs a little rum therapy.

feeds.title: Bahama Bob's Rumstyles Blog
feeds.description: This is a blog that will take you through the Rum lifestyles of a fine group of people that enjoy the fun and pleasure of fine rums. We will travel to distilleries, parties, and Rum Events to bring you the Rumstyles of all those we come in contact with.

feeds.title: Diplomático Rum Blog
feeds.description: Looking for the latest news on the rum scene? This is the place! Learn about cocktails of the season, brand stories, and what customers love about spirits. Diplomatico is a rum passionately crafted by rum masters, using their expertise in combining modern and traditional distillation methods.

feeds.title: 5 Minutes of Rum Blog
feeds.description: Having plunged headfirst into rum in 2009, I've created a space to share rum-related information while at the same time learning how to podcast.

feeds.title: Yolo Rum Blog
feeds.description: Yolo Rums are made from rare strains of sugar cane found only in small areas of Central America and the Caribbean. A specially prepared sugar cane juice is fermented and distilled through a complex, five-stage series of operations. Read our blog to know more bout our rums, how they can be consumed, what can be made with them, and many more!

feeds.title: Florida Rum Society Blog
feeds.description: Florida Rum Society's vision is to make Florida the 'GO TO' place for rum by working to bring quality products, options, and information to the Rum Lovers of Florida and beyond. Our mission is to help Floridians realize there is a Rum out there for everyone!

feeds.title: Rum Nation
feeds.description: the story of Rum Nation is that of an award-winning brand, distributed around the world, well known and highly appreciated by rum lovers of all nations - with a history that reaches back more than twenty years.

feeds.title: Spirits Hunters » Rum
feeds.description: Read about the different varieties of rum & gin, how much are they worth, how they should be consumed, and many more! Through the Spirits Hunters Worldwide Gin, your distillery will gain valuable worldwide visibility.

feeds.title: The Rum Howler Blog
feeds.description: The Rum Howler Blog is a blog all about rum-related things, it provides reviews on different rums like Plantation Isle of Fiji Rum, Last Mountain Single Cask Single Malt Whisky, Offrian Rum, and many more just like this!

feeds.title: Craft Rum Club
feeds.description: Each month the Craft Rum Club selects one of the world's finest rums, including rare & strictly limited bottlings - delivered to your door! Craft Rum Club is a UK-based subscription service and the first of its kind to offer premium crafted rums from around the world.

feeds.title: Copalli Blog
feeds.description: Copalli Rum is crafted from organic sugar cane grown on the adjacent Copal Tree Farm, the Copal Tree Distillery supports sustainable agriculture causes in Southern Belize by producing and selling premium organic, gluten-free spirits. Get to out our blog to read articles, news, and stories, all related to rum!

feeds.title: The Rum Tribe
feeds.description: The Rum Tribe's mission is to increase our member's love, appreciation, and understanding of premium rums. We achieve this by sourcing the best, rarest, hard-to-find, different and tasty rums that meet our member's price range and deliver it to our members. Read our blog to know about what kind of rums we serve and all about it!
